key_insight: An AI-assisted evaluation pipeline improves the reliability of judging research-level mathematical proofs across natural language, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
engineering_relevance: Multi-format proof evaluation offers a methodology for validating AI-generated mathematics and supporting code in scientific workflows.
method: Analyze submissions to research-level number theory problems in the Ramanujan Challenge.
Assess semantic and logical correctness across natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
Compare pipeline judgments with conventional one-shot LLM judgments.
evidence_signal: The pipeline reduced false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and increased judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%.
watch_item: Residual errors remain substantial for supporting code, and the abstract does not establish generalization beyond the Challenge submissions.
paper_title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
